mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pe_execution_context WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pe_execution_context SET context_data = JSON_SET( context_data, CONCAT('$.', #{nodeId}), CAST(#{outputJson} AS JSON) ), updater = 'SYSTEM', update_time = NOW(3) WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND deleted = 0
